text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown schedules QA & testing from Mar 1 to Mar 20, 2027, and the public launch on March 15, 2027.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"QA & testing | Mar 1 - Mar 20, 2027"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"Public launch | March 15, 2027"}]},{"text":"Under that timeline, QA ends on Mar 20, 2027, after the March 15, 2027 launch, so QA does not finish before the launch.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"QA & testing | Mar 1 - Mar 20, 2027"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"Public launch | March 15, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027, which is after QA's scheduled end of Mar 20, 2027.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s3","quote":"the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027 to allow additional time for smart TV integration testing"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"QA & testing | Mar 1 - Mar 20, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Project Overview Document gives the planned launch date as March 15, 2027.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s3","quote":"the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027"}]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Public launch date","claim_indexes":[3,4]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
